incidents.title: Provider reported 6 payment.failed events
incidents.summary: The provider sent 6 payment.failed events within 5 minutes. This is what the PROVIDER reported, not what our own records show — the two can diverge, and this rule reads the event store so a burst is visible before it lands on rows we own.
